teaching_contrasts.now: One Giving route can contain contributions to candidate committees, PAC/PC-style committees, party-style committees, and an issue or referendum committee.
teaching_contrasts.why: Sharing the contribution route does not make those political objects equivalent.
teaching_contrasts.exact: Route membership may support comparison, but it may not silently infer committee kind, candidate status, office, or political-object authority.

teaching_contrasts.now: BikiniBottomVotes fixes practice geography to Bikini Bottom, Oceania while real State, Municipal, and jurisdiction selectors sleep.
teaching_contrasts.why: A fictional practice source must never look combinable with a live real-world filing geography or imply that those custodians were queried.
teaching_contrasts.exact: Practice may narrow the aperture to a declared fictional jurisdiction, but real geography controls remain inert until exit and no real filing source may be consulted from that route.
